name: clones_same_title_same_location_first_url
spec_quote: clones — when the best-scoring postings all have the same title and the same location text (compared case-insensitively) but different URLs, they are one opening posted as several requisitions: the first of them (in input order) is returned.

name: clones_location_compared_case_insensitively_first_url
spec_quote: when the best-scoring postings all have the same title and the same location text (compared case-insensitively) but different URLs, they are one opening posted as several requisitions: the first of them (in input order) is returned.

name: same_title_two_cities_city_breaks_tie
spec_quote: Several postings tie on the best score with different URLs → the single one whose location contains the row's city; none, or more than one with different URLs → null.

name: same_title_two_cities_no_city_match_null
spec_quote: Several postings tie on the best score with different URLs → the single one whose location contains the row's city; none, or more than one with different URLs → null.

name: greater_filler_words_tampa_named
spec_quote: The row's city counts as named in a posting location when any word of city_of(location) that has ≥ 4 letters and is not greater / area / metro / metropolitan / region / county / downtown appears (as a substring, lower-case) in the posting location ... "Greater Tampa Bay Area" is named by "US - Tampa, FL (Lithia area)".

name: city_only_short_and_filler_words_whole_city_string_must_appear
spec_quote: when the city has no such word, the whole city string must appear. (city_of("Bay Area, CA") = "bay area"; the words "bay" and "area" are short/filler, so "bay area" must appear — it does in "San Francisco Bay Area".)

name: single_posting_other_city_null
spec_quote: that posting, unless: the row has a city (city_of(location) non-empty), the posting location is non-empty, the posting location does not contain the city, ... → null (same title in another city = a different opening).

name: single_posting_51_locations_chosen
spec_quote: unless: ... the posting location does not say "<N> Locations", "remote", "multiple", "united states", "nationwide" or equal "us" ... → null

name: tie_two_postings_both_contain_city_null
spec_quote: Best-scoring postings that differ in title or location still need the row's city to pick exactly one (as before). ... Several postings tie on the best score with different URLs → the single one whose location contains the row's city; none, or more than one with different URLs → null.

name: posting_location_us_equals_us_exception_chosen
spec_quote: unless: the row has a city (city_of(location) non-empty), the posting location is non-empty, the posting location does not contain the city, the posting location does not say "<N> Locations", "remote", "multiple", "united states", "nationwide" or equal "us", and the row's title does not contain the city → null
